issue.body: When trying to visit `starlette.io`, you get an error because the DNS record is only defined for `www.starlette.io`. This is fine, but it would be nice if it could redirect to `www.starlette.io` because then I don't have to type so much until it autocompletes in my web browser. I believe it used to work without the `www`, but it's been a while so I'm not sure.
issue.title: starlette.io is inaccessible without www prefix
